svg.title: Each input parameter to DecoderLayer.forward explained
svg.desc: Defines x, enc_out, src_mask, and tgt_mask: what each contains, its shape, where it comes from, and which sub-layer uses it.
svg.text: Four inputs to DecoderLayer.forward — what each one means

g.text: 1. x — the decoder's running hidden state
What it is
The target-side stream of hidden vectors that grows richer as it flows through each
decoder layer. At layer 1, it's the target token embeddings + positional encoding.
At layer 2, it's layer 1's output. At layer N, it's layer N−1's output.
Shape
(batch, tgt_len, embed_dim) e.g. (32, 7, 512) for batch=32, target length 7, dim 512
Where it comes from
First call: target embedding lookup + positional encoding + input dropout.
Subsequent calls: the previous decoder layer's output. Reassigned each loop iteration.
Used by
Self-attention (as Q, K, and V — all three!)
2. enc_out — the encoder's final source representation
What it is
The encoder's complete, contextualized understanding of the source sentence.
Each row is a source token's vector after 6 layers of self-attention have let it
"see" every other source token. This is the source's filing cabinet.
Shape
(batch, src_len, embed_dim) e.g. (32, 10, 512) — note the src_len, not tgt_len
Where it comes from
Computed once by the encoder stack at the top of the forward pass. The SAME
tensor is then threaded through every decoder layer — never modified, never recomputed.
Used by
Cross-attention (as K and V — twice, same tensor)
3. src_mask — source padding mask
What it is
A boolean mask marking which positions in the source are real tokens (1) and
which are padding (0). Padding exists because sentences in a batch get padded
to a common length. The mask makes sure cross-attn ignores those PAD positions.
Shape
(batch, 1, 1, src_len) — broadcasts over heads and query positions
Where it comes from
Built once at the start: (src != pad_token_id).unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2)
Used by
Cross-attention (since K, V are from source)
4. tgt_mask — causal mask AND target padding mask combined
What it is
Two masks combined with logical AND:
• Causal lower-triangular mask: position i can only see positions ≤ i (no peeking)
• Target padding mask: positions marked as PAD in the target are blocked
Shape
(batch, 1, tgt_len, tgt_len) — the (tgt_len, tgt_len) part is the causal triangle
Where it comes from
tgt_pad_mask = (tgt != pad_id).unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2)
causal_mask = torch.tril(torch.ones(tgt_len, tgt_len)).bool()
tgt_mask = tgt_pad_mask & causal_mask

svg.text: Used by: self-attention (since Q, K, V all from target)
